thought.text: Now re-run pnpm install with a clean Nx state.

reasoning_content:
version:stamp succeeded (the fatal git error was within the tool but exit 0 — it stamped "dev"). The generated about.json was written.

Next, re-run pnpm install. prepare should be fast now (nx cache already cleared, tasks re-run). The FK constraint error was due to a corrupted .nx DB — already deleted.

action.command:
cd /workspace/app && nohup pnpm install --trust-lockfile --network-concurrency 10 --fetch-timeout 120000 --fetch-retries 5 --fetch-retry-mintimeout 2000 --fetch-retry-maxtimeout 60000 > /tmp/pnpm-install3.log 2>&1 &
echo "install3 pid $!"; sleep 60; tail -5 /tmp/pnpm-install3.log; pgrep -f "pnpm install" >/dev/null && echo RUNNING || echo DONE
